sampling_rate: tiered (TEAM-3376): 100% gate roles (requirements_analyst, qa_verifier, ci_agent), 25% all others
evaluators: Builtin.Helpfulness (TRACE) — standard agents only; requirements_analyst swaps it for the custom evaluator

custom_evaluators._note: TEAM-3103: dependency_chain_evaluator.json rubric corrected to route QA through code_reviewer (design -> dev -> code_reviewer -> qa_verifier -> ci/security), matching the actual pipeline. Applied via in-place 'agentcore eval evaluator update' where the IDs above are unchanged. If the evaluator was instead recreated (new account-generated ID), refresh the IDs above and CUSTOM_EVALUATOR in setup-evaluations.sh — see that script's re-registration comment block.

_configs_note: Snapshot only — not load-bearing. The '-XXXX' suffixes are account-specific and regenerated on each setup-evaluations.sh run; consumers read evalConfigName from agents.json, which refresh-agents-json.sh repopulates by querying live CW log groups. Keys use the canonical long form 'eval_<agentId>' (e.g. eval_agentcore_hub_requirements_analyst), matching what setup-evaluations.sh creates.
_reapply_note: TEAM-3376: the live account configs still carry the OLD 10-evaluator/100% matrix until an operator runs the reconciliation procedure in setup-evaluations.sh (list -> delete mismatched -> refresh-agents-json.sh -> re-run script). Re-record the resulting config ids here afterwards — do not paste ids that haven't been created.

notes.trajectory_evaluators: TrajectoryInOrderMatch/ExactOrderMatch/AnyOrderMatch require reference inputs — only usable in on-demand evaluations, not online
notes.custom_evaluator_note: dependency_chain_compliance (on-demand version) uses {actual_tool_trajectory} placeholder — use for scheduled batch evaluations
notes.dependency_chain_agents: TEAM-3376 design §3.1: ONLY requirements_analyst has the custom evaluator — it is the sole role that creates the ticket dependency graph. qa_verifier and ci_agent were removed (they only transition tickets; scoring them on chain compliance produced guaranteed failures). lambda/eval-packager/index.mjs role-guards against drift here.
notes.evaluator_matrix: TEAM-3376: trimmed 10 -> 5 per config (each evaluator is an Opus judge call per sampled session). Standard agents: ToolSelectionAccuracy, InstructionFollowing, Correctness, Helpfulness, GoalSuccessRate. requirements_analyst: same minus Helpfulness, plus dependency_chain_compliance_online.
notes.sampling: TEAM-3376 tiered sampling: gate roles (requirements_analyst, qa_verifier, ci_agent) at 100%, all other agents at 25% — keeps the Opus judge under its RPM quota. See 'Eval judge throttling (quota)' in docs/orchestration-tracing-guide.md.
notes.monitoring_region: eval-success-rate-alarm.json and eval-health-dashboard.json hard-code us-east-1 (pure JSON can't carry comments); substitute the region at apply time — see the TEAM-3376 comment block in setup-evaluations.sh.
notes.max_evaluators: API limit is 10 evaluators per config; the TEAM-3376 matrix uses 5, so the limit is no longer binding.
